exposure: Previous use of oral contraceptive pill
finding: D-dimer levels were significantly affected by several factors, including previous oral contraceptive pill use, parity, and mode of delivery, suggesting these factors should be considered when interpreting D-dimer levels in pregnancy.
mod_finding: Women who underwent elective caesarean section had significantly lower D-dimer levels compared to those who had a spontaneous onset of labor, induction of labor, normal vaginal delivery, instrumental vaginal delivery, or emergency caesarean section.
